name: 63143 · Saint Louis, MO
findings: ZIP 63143 (Saint Louis) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63143 (Saint Louis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 63143 (Saint Louis) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 7 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
